page: Amazon Web Services i8ge.18xlarge is a storage-optimized and memory-expanded cloud instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor and AWS ARMv9 Neoverse-V2 architecture. The instance provides 72 dedicated physical cores running at 2.8 GHz, with 1 thread per core and no simultaneous multithreading. Compute resources are coupled with 576 GB of system memory, maintaining an 8 GB per vCPU allocation ratio, alongside 45,000 GB of high-speed local NVMe SSD storage and 112 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth. Hardware acceleration for graphics is absent, as the server incorporates zero GPUs.

Benchmark measurements indicate exceptional multi-core throughput and memory subsystems, contrasted with moderate single-threaded performance. The instance achieves top-tier results in Geekbench multi-core processing (25,790.0) and Clang software compilation (81,792.0), while single-core scores sit in the median distribution. Uncached large-block memory read bandwidth reaches 475.09 GB/sec and write bandwidth hits 215.77 GB/sec, placing it in the top 10 percent of evaluated systems. This memory architecture translates directly to outstanding in-memory data processing, shown by 148.38 million operations per second in Redis SET evaluations and top-tier PassMark database operation scores.

The qualitative efficiency profile of the i8ge.18xlarge is anchored by its resource density. By combining extensive Arm-based core counts, significant memory reserves, and massive integrated NVMe storage on a single instance, it minimizes the network overhead and management complexity typically associated with multi-node clusters. However, workloads dependent on x86 instruction sets or those bound by per-core execution latency will see less utility compared to high-frequency x86 platforms.

This hardware footprint makes the instance suited for large-scale distributed databases, extensive NoSQL installations, in-memory caching platforms such as Redis, large batch-decompression pipelines, and real-time big data analytics requiring high local disk density and rapid network transfers.
description: Amazon Web Services i8ge.18xlarge is an arm64 storage-optimized instance driven by 72 dedicated AWS ARMv9 Neoverse-V2 cores operating at 2.8 GHz on the Nitro hypervisor. The configuration features 576 GB of RAM, offering an expansive 8 GB per vCPU ratio, alongside an integrated 45,000 GB local NVMe SSD array and a 112 Gbps baseline network interface. In benchmark assessments, the platform demonstrates top-tier multi-core computing, large-block memory bandwidth exceeding 475 GB/sec, and high-velocity transactional capacity with over 148 million Redis SET operations per second, though single-thread metrics remain in the median range. Without dedicated GPUs, its performance and qualitative cost efficiency stem from dense physical core counts, high memory-to-core ratios, and voluminous low-latency local storage. The i8ge.18xlarge is suited for data-intensive workloads including distributed NoSQL databases, extensive in-memory caches, large-scale search indexing, and high-throughput real-time data processing engines.
